description: This source file defines the 'Statistics' class within the Opencart.Admin.Controller.Event namespace. The class extends a controller and includes methods for handling review and return-related statistics, such as adding and deleting review or return data, and updating corresponding statistics entries.

classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: Controller class responsible for updating statistical data related to reviews and returns when these actions occur.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Handles the event triggered after a review is added; updates the 'review' statistic by incrementing its count.

methods.name: deleteReview
methods.description: Handles the event triggered after a review is deleted; updates the 'review' statistic by decrementing its count.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Handles the event triggered after a return is added; updates the 'returns' statistic by incrementing its count.

methods.name: deleteReturn
methods.description: Handles the event triggered after a return is deleted; updates the 'returns' statistic by decrementing its count.
